mentions.name: rainy-city.com
mentions.description: This site is an ambient rain sound generator that doubles as a kind of city simulation, designed more as an ambient experience than a city simulator. It currently generates rain sounds; buildings and city features are works in progress (tiling is being rebuilt), with elements like whales planned.
